repos_data.description: ZSH plugin that automagically detects and activates your python environments (poetry, virtualenv, conda) while traversing directories.
A simple zsh plugin that automatically activates VS Code shell integration when working in VS Code terminals.
Simple zsh plugin to activate python venv on cd

repo_meta_data.description: Zsh plugin that automatically activates and deactivates Conda environments when you `cd` into or out of project directories containing an `environment.yml/environment.yaml`. Keeps your shell in the right environment without manual `conda activate`.
